# Upstage

> Upstage is an enterprise AI company building intelligence for the future of work, named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2026. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Seoul with offices in San Jose and Tokyo, Upstage develops the Solar family of large language models and the industry-leading Document AI suite, serving Fortune 500 enterprises across insurance, financial services, manufacturing, and public sector. Backed by Amazon, AMD, and SoftBank Ventures, Upstage offers all products via OpenAI-compatible API endpoints and through AWS Marketplace.

## Company

- [About Upstage](https://www.upstage.ai/about): Company overview, mission, leadership, and global offices (Seoul, San Jose, Tokyo)
- [Blog](https://www.upstage.ai/blog): Product announcements, technical deep dives, and company news
- [News](https://www.upstage.ai/news): Press releases and media coverage
- [GitHub](https://github.com/upstageai): Open-source projects, cookbooks, and code examples

## Console & Getting Started

- [Upstage Console](https://console.upstage.ai/): Dashboard for API key management, usage monitoring, and playground
- [Quickstart Guide](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started): Step-by-step setup guide—sign up, get an API key, and make your first request
- [API Reference](https://console.upstage.ai/api/chat): Complete API reference with endpoint specs and parameters
- [Models Catalog](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/models): All available models with pricing, context lengths, and version history
- [Pricing](https://www.upstage.ai/pricing): Pay-as-you-go pricing for all API products
- [For AI Coding Assistants](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/for-agents): API reference optimized for AI agents and coding assistants
- [Support Center](https://support.upstage.ai/): Technical support and troubleshooting

## Solar LLM

- [Solar Pro 3](https://www.upstage.ai/blog/en/solar-pro-3-0127): Flagship MoE LLM with 102B total / 12B active parameters and 128K context window. Best-in-class Korean language performance with English and Japanese support. Supports chat, reasoning, structured outputs, and function calling (model ID: `solar-pro3`)
- [Solar Pro 2](https://www.upstage.ai/blog/en/solar-pro-2-launch): 31B-parameter LLM with 65K context. Chat and reasoning modes with native tool-use and function-calling, purpose-built for agentic and RAG workflows (model ID: `solar-pro2`)
- [Solar Mini](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/models/solar-mini): Lightweight 10.7B-parameter LLM with 32K context, optimized for high-throughput production serving at the lowest cost (model ID: `solar-mini`)
- [Solar LLM API Docs](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/capabilities/generate/chat): OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoint for all Solar models (solar-pro3, solar-pro2, solar-mini)—drop-in replacement for existing OpenAI integrations

## Upstage Studio

- [Upstage Studio](https://www.upstage.ai/products/studio): Agentic AI document processing solution built entirely on proprietary technology. Combines Document Parse, Information Extract, and Solar LLM into a unified platform where enterprises can train and deploy models that support complex queries, multi-step reasoning workflows, and fine-grained interpretation of user intent—without compromising reliability
- [Studio Documentation](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/studio-and-agents/studio): Technical guide for building and deploying agentic workflows with Upstage Studio

## Document Processing

- [Document Parse](https://www.upstage.ai/products/document-parse): Industry-leading document parser that converts PDFs, scans, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HWP into structured HTML or Markdown. TEDS 93.48 (outperforming Google and Microsoft by 5%+), up to 10x faster than alternatives (model ID: `document-parse`)
- [Information Extract](https://www.upstage.ai/products/information-extract): Schema-agnostic key-value extraction that outputs structured JSON from any document with zero training—no templates or fine-tuning required (model ID: `information-extract`)
- [Document Parse Enhanced](https://www.upstage.ai/blog/en/document-parse-enhanced): Advanced visual understanding mode for complex tables, checkboxes, charts, and diagrams, achieving 99% accuracy across contracts, invoices, and financial statements
- [Document Processing API Docs](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/capabilities/parse): Full API reference for Document Parse (document-parse), OCR (ocr), and Information Extract (information-extract)

## Embeddings & Search

- [Solar Embedding](https://www.upstage.ai/blog/en/solar-embedding-1-large): Solar Embedding-1-Large model for text embeddings, with separate query and passage models in a unified vector space for high-performance retrieval
- [Embedding API Docs](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/capabilities/embed): API reference for embedding endpoints

## Integrations & Ecosystem

- [LangChain Integration](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/integrations/providers/upstage): Official LangChain provider for Solar LLM, Document Parse, and Embeddings
- [MCP Server](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/guides/mcp-server): Model Context Protocol server for integrating Upstage APIs with AI coding assistants
- [AWS Marketplace](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/seller-profile?id=seller-56j52of2hnuzo): All Upstage products available on AWS Marketplace, including Document Parse, Information Extract, and Solar Mini
- [Cookbook & Examples](https://github.com/UpstageAI/cookbook): Jupyter notebooks and sample code for all Upstage APIs

## Optional

- [Solar Pro on AWS](https://www.upstage.ai/news/solar-pro-aws): Details on the Upstage and AWS partnership for AI innovation in APAC and the US
- [EduStage](https://edu.upstage.ai/): Educational resources and tutorials for getting started with Upstage APIs
